components.name: ::oodz::superClass
components.summary: Root OODZ NX class providing shared NaviServer location and version properties.

components.name: ::oodz::baseClass
components.summary: Base NX class for dynamic object properties, dictionary loading, inspection, clearing, replacing, and serialization.

components.name: ::oodz::baseObj
components.summary: Abstract table-backed domain object with identifier loading, database persistence, deletion, and automatic table-column properties.

components.name: ::SQLBuilder
components.summary: Builds SELECT and COUNT SQL with columns, conditions, joins, grouping, ordering, searching, date ranges, limits, and offsets.

components.name: ::InsertSQLBuilder
components.summary: Builds INSERT SQL for multiple rows with RETURNING, column transforms, and conflict handling.

components.name: ::UpdateSQLBuilder
components.summary: Builds UPDATE SQL with value dictionaries, conditions, and optional column transformations.

components.name: ::DeleteSQLBuilder
components.summary: Builds DELETE SQL with conditions, joins, limits, and offsets.

components.name: ::oodz::db
components.summary: OODZ PostgreSQL and NaviServer database helper class for pooled execution and common data operations.

components.name: ::oodz::dateTime
components.summary: Configuration-aware date, time, timestamp, timezone, formatting, comparison, and range helper.

components.name: ::oodz::Json
components.summary: Base JSON helper for identifying JSON arrays and objects and determining JSON value shape.

components.name: ::oodz::JsonObj / ::oodz::JsonArr
components.summary: OODZ JSON object and array classes built on the common Json helper.

components.name: ::oodz::fileStorage
components.summary: Table-backed file storage object for MIME handling, filesystem persistence, and database metadata.

components.name: ::httpClientClass
components.summary: NaviServer HTTP client supporting GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, headers, request bodies, query parameters, and JSON responses.

components.name: ::oodz::api / ::apiin
components.summary: REST endpoint dispatch and incoming request handling for methods, headers, JSON, forms, text, binary bodies, and responses.

components.name: ::oodz::htmlWrapper
components.summary: Server-side HTML and form rendering wrapper with translation, input, button, conditional rendering, and database-table helpers.

components.name: ::oodz::SessionFactory
components.summary: Creates OODZ session implementations backed by files or databases.

components.name: ::oodz::Crypto / ::oodz::Sanitize
components.summary: Shared cryptography and input-sanitization helper objects.
